description: This file defines controller functions for handling execution-related API endpoints, including retrieving, updating, and deleting executions, using express request/response objects and an executions service.

methods.name: getExecutionById
methods.description: Fetches an execution by ID, considering workspace context.

methods.name: getPublicExecutionById
methods.description: Fetches a public execution by ID.

methods.name: updateExecution
methods.description: Updates an execution with provided data.

methods.name: getAllExecutions
methods.description: Retrieves all executions with optional filters and pagination.

methods.name: deleteExecutions
methods.description: Deletes one or multiple executions based on provided IDs.
